prompt:

| Return 3m            | +4.9% |
| Return 1m            | +5.5% |
| Return 1w            | +2.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 80% |
| 21d realized vol     | 29% |
| Last close           | 301.74 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has positive short- to medium-term momentum (1m and 3m returns), but it is currently at about the 80th percentile of its 63-day range and displays elevated realized vol (21d vol ~29%), implying potential near-term consolidation or a pullback rather than a clear uptrend.

DECISION: HOLD
